facts.fact: Fraternite reports that at a Digital Rights Academy workshop on 1 July 2026, jurists, researchers and parliamentarians, including Dr Julien Hounkpe, criticised Article 550 of the Digital Code on false information and called for proportionate sanctions and a targeted reform.

BEN.note: The document names a workshop and a jurist but no local research institution, centre or publication on digital policy.
The workshop was a Digital Rights Academy event, not stated to have been convened by government, parliament or a regulator on a named law.
